decisionsTitle: Volunteer badges designed like the bibs and printed per role, with a space for the name
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14 ~07:05:** «Și trebuie să putem face design și printa ecusoane de voluntari (similar cu BIB-urile)». **Then, ~07:10:** «Badge-urile sunt de obicei mai mici și mai lungi și fără nume, numele îl scriem manual cu markerul».

**Decision.** An event's volunteer badges are designed and printed on a page of their own under the event, «Ecusoane pentru voluntari» (`/admin/events/[id]/badges`), reached from the «Voluntari» card by one button — the event editor is long enough, and the card's role form is the volunteers' own. Whoever runs the event's volunteers may use it: the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canDesignVolunteerBadges`, written as `canManageVolunteers`), asserted in the page, the two actions, the service and both routes; the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member meet a 404 on the page and a 403 from the routes.

- **No name is printed.** A badge is a small, long strip: the header band (the club's blue or one of the bib palette's colours, or the club's picture across it), the club's logo at its left as its file is — blue on its own white ground, never recoloured — and the event's short title at its right (the club's, both languages or neither, else the event's own title, shrunk then cut to fit); the role's band in the role's colour with «VOLUNTAR» small above the role's name; a white writing area with «Nume:» and, if the club wants it, one faint line for the marker; optionally «Telefon coordonator», the club's number with its label in both languages, checked as the bib's emergency number is (§750). The writing area never has less than 10 mm of height: at a small size the two bands above give up their share. The badge carries the club's words and a role, never a volunteer: the sheet reads no volunteer at all, so the file holds no personal data and needs no download trail of its own.
- **Sizes.** 90 × 35 mm by default (16 on an A4 sheet), 100 × 40 mm (14), or the club's own width × height in whole millimetres within 60–200 × 30–100. The badges are butted edge to edge inside a 5 mm page margin, each with its own 2 mm white border for the scissors, a dashed hairline on every cut and — with «Semne de tăiere pe margine», on by default — a short solid mark in the margin at both ends of each cut. The page says how many fit.
- **Each role has a band colour**: «Culoarea temei» (the kit's orange, never the header's blue), one of the bib palette's colours, or a colour typed beside «Altă culoare». A colour is saved only when white or the body ink, whichever reads better, reads on it at AA (4.5 : 1); the palette's green does not and is not offered, and a stored colour that does not read prints the theme's. The colours are chosen on the badges' page, per role (`event_volunteer_roles.colour`), not in the «Voluntari» card's role form, which stays the volunteers' card's alone.
- **Printing is per role**, never per person: «Câte ecusoane» per role — by default the people the role needs — and «În plus» spares, then «Ecusoane fără rol» with «VOLUNTAR» alone for whoever comes without one. The badges print in one language, chosen on the form like the bib's (the page's by default): the words, the title and the roles' names in it. The file's own properties say how many badges it holds. At most 300 of a pile and 1 000 in a file.
- **The bib's machinery, reused, not copied**: the designer's named sections (`Panel`, level 5, a glyph each), the live preview (`BibDesignPreview` with `kind="badge"`), the picture place with its crop box and «Calitate» row (`BibPictureField` with `place="badge"` and the header's shape at the saved size), the warning that a picture hides the title (`BibHeaderWarning`), the bib header's and small print's font tables for every fit, the crop rule (`pictureDrawingIn`, the bib's `bibPictureDrawing` generalised), one geometry for the pdfkit sheet and the Satori picture (`badge-geometry.ts`), and a stamp in each picture's address (`badgePictureStamp`, its own drawing version).
- **Data.** Migration `0150_volunteer_badges`, expand only: `events.badge_design` (jsonb, null is the platform's design, read by `readBadgeDesign`, which never throws) and `event_volunteer_roles.colour` (text, a hex triplet by `CHECK`, null is the theme's). The event file (§751) carries the badge design under `badges.design`, its header picture among the media (`badge.header`), labelled in the diff; a file made before it reads as the platform's badge. A copy of the event («Duplică», a series' dates) keeps the design. The media sweep keeps a badge's picture and a delete is refused while one prints it.

**Refused.** Printing the volunteer's name — the owner's correction: names are written by hand, and a sheet without names needs no personal data. Per-person printing, for the same reason. A colour field in the «Voluntari» card's role form — the card belongs to the volunteers' lane, and a role's colour is a badge's matter. **Carrying the roles' colours in the event file**: the file deliberately carries no role (§754: a copy of an event starts with none), so a role's colour has nothing to attach to on the other side; the colours stay with their roles, and the owner may decide otherwise. A colour picker without a contrast check — a role's name nobody can read on a yellow band is a badge that does not work.
changelogLine: - **Volunteer badges, designed like the bibs and printed per role** — «Ecusoane pentru voluntari», linked from the «Voluntari» card: a small, long strip (90 × 35 mm, 100 × 40 mm or the club's own size) with the logo, the event's short title, «VOLUNTAR», the role on its coloured band and a white space for the name written by hand, optionally the coordinator's telephone; each role's colour from the palette or typed, checked for contrast; «Câte ecusoane» per role with spares and badges without a role, packed on A4 with cut marks. No volunteer's name is ever printed. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event, when the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator presses «Ecusoane pentru voluntari» on its «Voluntari» card, then the page `/admin/events/[id]/badges` shows «Cum arată ecusonul» — named folds top to bottom as the badge prints («Dimensiunea», «Antet», «Rolul», «Locul pentru nume», «Telefon coordonator», «Tăiere»), each with a glyph and a closed line — with a preview redrawn from the unsaved boxes; «Salvează ecusonul» keeps the design on the event and writes one audit row with the settings changed, a save that changes nothing writes nothing, and a custom size outside 60–200 × 30–100 whole millimetres, a short title, «VOLUNTAR» or a telephone label in one language only, a telephone not written like one, or a band colour no word reads on at AA is refused naming the box with every box kept (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

Given a badge of any size within the bounds, then the header band, the role's band, the writing area and the telephone's row fill the badge inside its 2 mm border edge to edge, the writing area is never less than 10 mm tall, the role's name fits its band's width — kept at its size when it fits, shrunk by half points down to 6 points, and only then cut with «…» — and the title, «VOLUNTAR», «Nume:» and the telephone do the same in their rows; the sheet and the picture draw the same layout; 90 × 35 mm badges print 16 to an A4 sheet and 100 × 40 mm badges 14, every badge inside a 5 mm margin, none overlapping, with a dashed line on every cut and, while «Semne de tăiere pe margine» is ticked, a solid mark in the margin at both ends of each (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-geometry.test.ts`, `volunteers/badges-pdf.test.ts`.

Given «Culorile rolurilor», when a role is given «Culoarea temei», a palette colour or a colour typed beside «Altă culoare», then it is kept on the role and audited with the role's id and name and the colour from and to; a typed text that is not `#rrggbb` is refused, and a colour on which neither white nor the body ink reads at AA is refused (`BADGE_COLOUR_UNREADABLE`) naming its box; only the event's own roles are changed; a stored colour that does not read prints the theme's (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; unit `volunteers/badge-geometry.test.ts`.

Given «Tipărire», when «Descarcă ecusoanele (PDF)» is pressed, then the PDF holds, per role, «Câte ecusoane» (the people the role needs unless changed) plus «În plus», then «Ecusoane fără rol» with «VOLUNTAR» alone, in the language chosen, packed on as many A4 pages as they take, its properties naming how many badges it holds; a count that is not a whole number from 0 to 300, or a total past 1 000, is refused (400) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; unit `volunteers/badges-pdf.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

Given an event with a badge design, when it is exported as a JSON file (§751), then the file carries the design under `badges.design` — never a volunteer and never a role — with its header picture among the media (`badge.header`); an import as a new event or over an event writes it (the diff naming `badges.design.*`), a file made before it reads as the platform's badge, and a copy of the event keeps the design. Migration `0150_volunteer_badges` is expand-only: `events.badge_design` (jsonb, nullable) and `event_volunteer_roles.colour` (text, nullable, a hex triplet by `CHECK`) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `events/event-json.test.ts`, `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; unit `events/event-json.test.ts`.

Given an event's volunteer badges, when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator — the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer (`CONTRIBUTOR`), a member, a stranger — opens the page, saves the design or a role's colour, or asks for the sheet or a badge's picture, then the page answers 404, the service refuses (FORBIDDEN), the routes answer 403 (401 for a stranger) whatever the page drew, and nothing is written (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; unit `staff/roles.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

Given the volunteer badges' sheet and pictures, then neither reads nor prints any volunteer's name, address, telephone number or message: a badge carries the club's words, the event's title and a role's name, and the name is written by hand in its white area (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badges-pdf.test.ts`.
